cases.why: log loss, Brier and AUC may differ in the fourth decimal and still pass. The confirmed cross-platform finding is agreement to four decimals, so a looser mark would pass real drift in the published figures.
accuracy may move three games. The allowance is the two-game cross-platform finding, and every game past it is a real difference being waved through.
a different number of games no longer fails the comparison. Metrics that agree over a different set of games prove nothing about the published ones.
two runs that disagree can still be called reproduced, as long as the first one happened to match.
cases.find: if all(r['ok'] for r in rows) and all(determinism.values()) else
cases.replace: if all(r['ok'] for r in rows) else
